summary: Knightscope filed a routine 8-K reporting an Item 8.01 prospectus supplement that increases the maximum shares issuable under its existing At The Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC, dated February 1, 2023, to up to $35,000,000 of Class A common stock, par value $0.001. The filing attaches a Haynes and Boone opinion. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is an ordinary shelf takedown capacity update, not a special situation; watch cumulative ATM dilution and Nasdaq compliance.
